overview.zh: 大规模数据泄露、链上攻击遇险与智能模型“严重”黑客能力，凸显数字安全威胁全面升级。 身份数据泄露：联邦调查局调查IDScan.net涉嫌泄露一亿五千三百万份美加驾照，规模罕见。 链上安全：TAC网络遭质押池攻击后冻结逾10天，财库拟动用12.6亿代币救助。 AI安全：OpenAI Astra获评其框架内首个“严重”黑客能力等级，并能自主串联两个未知零日漏洞。
overview.en: ID leak, frozen blockchain, and AI's 'critical' hacking capability spotlight escalating digital security risks. Identity Data Breach：The FBI is investigating IDScan.net over an alleged leak of 153 million US and Canadian driver licenses. Onchain Security：TAC network has stayed frozen for over 10 days after a staking-pool exploit, with a 1.26B token bailout proposed. AI Safety：OpenAI's Astra achieved a 'Critical' capability rating and autonomously chained two novel zero-day exploits.

title.zh: FBI调查IDScan.net涉嫌泄露超1.5亿份驾照信息
title.en: FBI investigates alleged IDScan.net breach exposing over 150M driver licenses

summary.zh:
美国联邦调查局(FBI)正在调查身份核验公司IDScan.net疑似发生的数据泄露事件。据称，暗网服务Nexus出售了超过1.5亿份美国和加拿大驾照信息，其中包括美国战争部长皮特·赫格塞斯的驾照。KrebsOnSecurity率先报道了这一疑似泄露事件，相关数据量也被描述为1.53亿条记录。

如果泄露属实，这将成为有记录以来规模最大的身份数据泄露事件之一，数百万驾车人的敏感个人信息面临身份盗窃和欺诈风险。此外，大量依赖IDScan.net的财富500强企业和机构也可能受到波及，并引发外界对第三方身份核验服务安全性的广泛担忧。

安全研究员vx-underground公布了一份可能受影响的IDScan.net客户名单，包括壳牌、DraftKings、联邦快递、赫兹、通用汽车、凯撒娱乐和摩托罗拉等。隐私研究员Zach Edwards表示，他在拉斯维加斯一家名为Planet13的大麻药房扫描证件后信息即遭泄露，种种迹象表明IDScan.net正遭受持续的实时入侵；Nexus声称其已持续窃取数据一年多，但该服务目前已无法访问。
summary.en:
The FBI is investigating an alleged data breach at identity verification firm IDScan.net after dark-web service Nexus reportedly offered over 150 million U.S. and Canadian driver licenses for sale, including one belonging to U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. KrebsOnSecurity first reported the apparent leak, which is also described as involving 153 million records.

If confirmed, this would be one of the largest identity data breaches on record, exposing millions of drivers' sensitive personal information to potential identity theft and fraud. The alleged breach also puts major Fortune 500 companies and institutions that rely on IDScan.net at risk and raises broader concerns about the security of third-party identity verification services.

Security researcher vx-underground published a list of IDScan.net clients that may be affected, including Shell, DraftKings, FedEx, Hertz, General Motors, Caesars Entertainment, and Motorola. Privacy researcher Zach Edwards said his ID was leaked after visiting Planet13, a Las Vegas cannabis dispensary, and that signs point to an ongoing real-time breach at IDScan.net; Nexus claims it has been continuously exfiltrating data for over a year but its service is currently unavailable.

title.zh: TAC网络遭质押池攻击冻结超10天，财库拟1.26B代币救助
title.en: TAC Network Frozen Over 10 Days After Exploit Spurs 1.26B Token Bailout

summary.zh:
TAC网络在8月22日质押池遭攻击后已停在区块24,671,475超过10天，共被盗走约29.9亿枚TAC，约占总供应量28.6%。提议中的恢复方案拟用财库储备补足约12.58亿枚已售出的TAC，但约16.6亿枚攻击者留在BNB Chain上的TAC如何处理仍悬而未决。

长时间停摆锁定了TAC用户的质押资金，并使其桥接与赎回功能中断；BNB Chain上未处置的约16.6亿枚TAC，也让大部分被盗代币的最终归属悬而未决。由于该漏洞模块被多个Cosmos-EVM链共用这一事实，事件影响并不只限于TAC本身。

攻击者利用的是算术溢出漏洞：EVM StateDB只跟踪可花费余额，而Cosmos SDK账本还允许委托锁定的归属代币，导致未校验的减法回绕至接近2^256，随后第二次溢出使攻击者可清空受害者账户而保留其合法代币。提议的恢复方案是在停止区块上做定向状态编辑而非回滚，可恢复质押池和委托人余额，同时保留来自218个无关地址的7,772笔正常交易。
summary.en:
The TAC network has remained halted at block 24,671,475 for over 10 days after an Aug. 22 exploit drained 2.99 billion TAC, roughly 28.6% of supply, from the bonded staking pool. The proposed recovery plan would replace the ~1.26 billion sold TAC from treasury reserves, while the treatment of ~1.66 billion attacker-held TAC on BNB Chain remains unresolved.

The prolonged halt traps staked funds and disables bridging and redemptions for TAC users, while the unresolved 1.66 billion TAC balance on BNB Chain leaves a large part of the drained supply in limbo. Because the vulnerable module is shared by multiple Cosmos-EVM chains, the incident has implications beyond TAC itself.

The attacker exploited an arithmetic overflow: the EVM StateDB tracked only spendable balances, while the Cosmos SDK ledger also allowed delegating locked vesting tokens, so an unchecked subtraction wrapped toward roughly 2^256 and a second overflow then let the attacker zero a victim account. The proposed recovery is a targeted state edit at the halt block, not a rollback, restoring the bonded pool and delegator balances while preserving 7,772 legitimate transactions from 218 unrelated addresses.

title.zh: OpenAI Astra 成首个具备“严重”黑客能力的AI模型
title.en: OpenAI's Astra Becomes First AI Model with 'Critical' Hacking Abilities

summary.zh:
9月1日，OpenAI 宣布其未发布的 Astra 模型达到其 Preparedness Framework 下的“严重”网络安全级别，这是首个获得该级别的模型。Astra 在 ExploitBench 上获得 100% 满分，并自主发现、串联利用了 Google V8 JavaScript 引擎中两个此前未知的零日漏洞。

这是AI安全与能力领域的前沿实验室里程碑，表明模型能够自主对加固后的真实世界系统执行完整入侵链条。它很可能影响访问限制、防御性AI计划，以及业界围绕灾难性网络风险的讨论。

OpenAI 表示 Astra 超过了此前最高为“高级”级别的 GPT-5.6 Sol；在内部测试中，Astra 拒绝了 91.5% 的网络越狱尝试，而 GPT-5.6 Sol 为 59%。早期访问从小型 alpha 测试组开始，后续将通过 Daybreak Blue 防御性安全计划扩大，目前尚未设定公开发布日期。
summary.en:
On September 1, OpenAI announced that its unreleased Astra model meets the "Critical" cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework, the first model to receive that designation. Astra scored a perfect 100% on ExploitBench and autonomously discovered and chained two previously unknown zero-days in Google's V8 JavaScript engine.

This is a frontier-lab milestone in AI safety and capability, showing that models can autonomously execute full compromise chains against hardened real-world systems. It will likely shape access restrictions, defensive AI programs, and industry-wide discussions about catastrophic cyber risk.

OpenAI says Astra tops GPT-5.6 Sol, which maxed out at the lower "High" tier, and Astra refused 91.5% of cyber jailbreak attempts in internal tests versus 59% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Access starts with a small alpha test group and will later expand through the Daybreak Blue defensive security program; a public launch date has not been set.

title.zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布Gemini 3.8 Flash，基准测试亮眼
title.en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.8 Flash with surprising benchmark strength

summary.zh:
谷歌DeepMind发布了Gemini 3.8 Flash，这是其Flash系列中一款快速且低成本的多模态模型，同时还推出了名为Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber的姊妹版本。社区测试对比显示，该Flash模型达到了以往Opus 5等旗舰模型的分数水平。

这次发布将接近旗舰级的基准得分带入了快速、低成本档位，拓宽了AI在延迟和成本敏感场景（如HTML/JavaScript生成和智能体工作流）中的实用范围，同时也加剧了谷歌、Anthropic、OpenAI及开源模型提供商之间的竞争。

早期社区测试显示，该模型的Artificial Analysis智能得分为59，与Opus 5持平；一项社区报告还显示它在DeepSwe排行榜上超过Opus 5并位居第一。开发者Simon Willison演示了仅用1.8美分、耗时13秒生成一个可交互HTML页面，体现了模型的速度与代码质量。
summary.en:
Google DeepMind has launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, a fast and low-cost multimodal model in its Flash lineup, and separately unveiled a sibling variant called Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber. Community-led benchmark comparisons show the flash model scoring at a level previously associated with flagship models like Opus 5.

By pushing flagship-level benchmark scores into a fast, cheap tier, this release widens the practical use cases for AI in latency- and cost-sensitive applications such as HTML/JavaScript generation and agentic workflows. It also intensifies competition among Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, and open-weight model providers.

Early community tests reported an Artificial Analysis intelligence score of 59, matching Opus 5, and the model topped the DeepSwe leaderboard ahead of Opus 5 in one community report. Developer Simon Willison demonstrated generating an interactive HTML page for 1.8 cents in 13 seconds, highlighting the model's speed and code quality.

title.zh: 谷歌胜诉：法院拒绝拆分其广告技术业务
title.en: Google Avoids Breakup as Judge Rejects DOJ Ad Tech Divestiture Bid

summary.zh:
2026年9月2日，美国弗吉尼亚州的一名联邦法官裁定，谷歌必须改变压低网页发布商广告费率的做法，但驳回了美国司法部（DOJ）要求强制出售其广告技术业务的请求。谷歌得以保留其广告交易平台及相关工具，避免了该业务被拆分。

这是一项重大的反垄断裁决，使Alphabet旗下的谷歌在美国一起标志性垄断案中免于最严厉的救济措施，也显示出美国针对科技行业的执法中结构性拆分的局限。那些认为拆分是必要措施的广告主、发行商和竞争对手，短期内不会看到他们期望的市场结构变化。

法官要求谷歌停止压低网页发布商广告费率的做法，但拒绝剥离其广告交易平台及相关技术。谷歌的广告技术业务去年收入约300亿美元，约占Alphabet总收入的8%；该业务收入已连续16个季度下滑，分析师估计其占公司利润的比例不到1%。
summary.en:
On September 2, 2026, a U.S. federal judge in Virginia ruled that Google must alter practices that depress web publisher ad rates, but rejected the Justice Department's request to force a sale of Google's ad tech business. Google will keep its ad exchange and associated tools, avoiding a structural breakup of this unit.

This is a major antitrust ruling that spares Alphabet's Google the most extreme remedy in a flagship monopolization case, signaling limits on structural breakups in U.S. tech enforcement. Advertisers, publishers, and competitors who argued that divestiture was necessary will not see the market structure change they sought.

The judge ordered Google to end practices that lower ad rates for web publishers but declined to divest its ad exchange and related technology. Google's ad tech business brought in about $30 billion, roughly 8 percent of Alphabet revenue, last year; its ad tech revenue has fallen for 16 straight quarters and analysts estimate it accounts for less than 1 percent of company profit.

title.zh: Coinbase在加拿大推出受监管的加密衍生品交易
title.en: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada

summary.zh:
Coinbase已在加拿大推出加密衍生品交易，面向合格客户提供比特币（BTC）、以太坊（ETH）、Solana（SOL）等资产的永续合约和定期期货。该服务通过Coinbase Financial Markets提供，包含23种加密期货、5种大宗商品期货以及Coinbase 50指数，并声称是大型加密原生平台在加拿大推出的首个原生加密期货产品。

此举扩大了加拿大受监管衍生品市场的准入范围，而该国加密资产持有率近年来大幅上升，也使Coinbase在加密原生竞争者中占据先机。同时表明，在整体监管压力增大的背景下，美国加密平台正将加拿大视为可行的受监管扩张市场。

服务仅面向符合条件的加拿大客户，包括拥有至少500万美元净金融资产的个人，以及注册投资顾问和交易商。合约采用迷你型“纳米”头寸，最高提供10倍杠杆，同时产品线还包括大宗商品期货和Coinbase 50指数。
summary.en:
Coinbase has launched crypto derivatives trading in Canada, offering eligible customers perpetual and dated futures on Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and other assets. The service, introduced via Coinbase Financial Markets, includes 23 crypto futures, five commodity futures and the Coinbase 50 Index, and is billed as the first native crypto futures offering from a major crypto-native platform in the country.

This expands regulated derivatives access in Canada, a market where crypto ownership has risen sharply, and positions Coinbase ahead of other crypto-native competitors. It also shows U.S. crypto platforms treating Canada as a viable regulated expansion market even as broader regulatory pressure increases.

Access is limited to eligible Canadian clients, including individuals with at least $5 million in net financial assets and registered investment advisers and dealers. The contracts use nano-sized positions, offer up to 10x leverage, and the offering also includes commodity futures and the Coinbase 50 Index.

title.zh: 新泽西州请求美国最高法院裁决预测市场管辖权
title.en: New Jersey asks US Supreme Court to decide prediction market rules

summary.zh:
2026年9月2日，新泽西州总检察长及博彩监管官员向美国最高法院提交调卷令申请，要求其裁定各州赌博法是否适用于受CFTC监管的预测市场Kalshi的体育赛事合约。这使新泽西州成为首个请求最高法院就预测市场问题表态的州。

如果最高法院同意受理，其裁决可能决定各州与CFTC谁对预测市场拥有最终监管权，进而影响Kalshi等平台在全美50个州的业务。这一结果将重塑快速增长的预测市场行业的监管格局。

该申请针对美国第三巡回上诉法院今年4月以2比1不利于新泽西州博彩监管机构的裁决，并质疑《多德-弗兰克法案》中的《商品交易法》是否优先于各州对CFTC注册市场所提供的体育博彩的监管权。新泽西州指出至少20个州已提起民事执法行动，而Kalshi则辩称无法同时遵守50个州各不相同的监管规则。
summary.en:
On Sept. 2, 2026, New Jersey's attorney general and gaming officials filed a petition for a writ of certiorari with the U.S. Supreme Court, asking it to decide whether state gambling laws apply to CFTC-regulated prediction market Kalshi's sports event contracts. This makes New Jersey the first state to ask the high court to weigh in on prediction markets.

If the Supreme Court agrees to hear the case, its decision could resolve whether states or the CFTC hold ultimate authority over prediction markets, affecting platforms such as Kalshi across all 50 states. The outcome would reshape the regulatory landscape for the fast-growing prediction market industry.

The petition challenges an April ruling in which the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit voted 2-1 against New Jersey gaming authorities, and asks whether the Dodd-Frank Act's Commodity Exchange Act preempts states from regulating sports bets offered on CFTC-registered markets. New Jersey notes that at least 20 states have pursued civil enforcement, while Kalshi argues it cannot comply with 50 different state regulators.

title.zh: OpenAI称其新型“Astra”人工智能无需人类帮助即可构建攻击
title.en: OpenAI says its new 'Astra' AI can build attacks without human help

summary.zh: OpenAI称其新型Astra人工智能可在无人协助的情况下自主构建网络攻击，引发重大的安全和安保担忧。
summary.en: OpenAI says its new Astra AI can autonomously build cyberattacks without human help, raising significant safety and security concerns.

title.zh: Layer 1 区块链 Injective 为阻止 490 万美元攻击停止出块 4 小时，却称只是升级
title.en: Layer-1 blockchain Injective halts for 4 hours to stop $4.9M exploit, calls it an upgrade

summary.zh:
9 月 1 日，Injective 在遭遇约 490 万美元的漏洞攻击（涉及二元期权市场）后，暂停出块近四个小时，让验证者部署紧急补丁。基金会称这是“升级而非停机”，并表示共识、原生 INJ 和质押资产均未受影响。

此次事件表明，即使是主流 Layer 1 的核心模块也可能存在可利用的逻辑漏洞，而遏制攻击可能需要暂停整条链，这引发了关于透明度和去中心化的疑问。这对 Injective 用户、验证者以及 Layer 1 安全与紧急治理的广泛讨论都很重要。

研究员 Earthling Paddy 质疑基金会“仅影响生态应用”的说法，指出攻击使用了 Injective 原生交易和保险模块的消息，而紧急补丁增加了保险基金计价单位检查并禁用了主网二元期权结算。8 月 31 日区块 181027005（16:09:59 UTC）之后链上停止生产约四小时，部分验证者因错过升级窗口被暂时监禁，Coinbase 和 Coins.ph 等交易所也临时限制了转账。
summary.en:
On Sept. 1, Injective paused block production for nearly four hours while validators deployed an emergency patch after an exploit drained roughly $4.9 million via binary-options markets. The foundation described the event as an 'upgrade, not halted' and said consensus, native INJ, and staked assets were not compromised.

The incident shows that even a major layer-1's core modules can contain exploitable logic, and that containing an attack may require halting the chain, which raises transparency and decentralization questions. It matters for Injective users, validators, and the broader L1 security and emergency governance discussion.

Researcher Earthling Paddy disputed the foundation's claim that the exploit only affected ecosystem applications, noting the attack used messages from Injective's native exchange and insurance modules, and that the emergency patch added an insurance-fund denomination check and disabled binary-options settlement on mainnet. Block 181027005 at 16:09:59 UTC on Aug. 31 was followed by roughly four hours of halted production; some validators were temporarily jailed and exchanges such as Coinbase and Coins.ph restricted transfers.

title.zh: Binance推出超千只美股及ETF实物交割期权
title.en: Binance launches physically settled options on 1,000+ US equities

summary.zh:
9月1日，Binance开始向符合条件的美国以外用户提供覆盖超过1000只精选美股和ETF的实物交割期权。订单由Nest Trading介绍并路由至Alpaca Securities，由其负责执行、清算和结算，并在行权后托管任何已交割的股票。

这使传统股票期权与加密货币及代币化股票产品同处一个Binance账户，符合条件的客户无需另开经纪账户。此举进一步深化Binance向传统金融（TradFi）的拓展，同时将受监管的证券执行和托管保留在Alpaca而非Binance手中。

这些期权为实物交割，因此行权看涨期权会交付标的股票，由Alpaca代用户托管。Binance表示，用户必须在到期前最迟30分钟内通过其平台提交行权指令；否则即使期权处于实值状态，也可能被尽力自动平仓，甚至到期作废。
summary.en:
On September 1, Binance began offering eligible non-US users physically settled options covering more than 1,000 selected US stocks and ETFs. Orders are introduced by Nest Trading and routed to Alpaca Securities, which executes, clears, settles, and holds any shares delivered after exercise.

This puts traditional equity options in the same Binance account as crypto and tokenized equity products, removing the need for eligible clients to open a separate brokerage account. It also deepens Binance's push into traditional finance while keeping regulated securities execution and custody with Alpaca rather than Binance.

The options are physically settled, so exercising a call delivers underlying shares that Alpaca holds on the user's behalf. Binance says users must submit exercise instructions through its platform up to 30 minutes before expiration; otherwise an in-the-money option may be auto-liquidated on a best-efforts basis or expire worthless.

title.zh: 币安为多资产平台新增美股期权
title.en: Binance Adds U.S. Stock Options to Multi-Asset Platform

summary.zh:
币安已将其多资产交易平台扩展至包含美股期权，让用户能够在加密货币资产之外交易传统股票衍生品。此举标志着币安从纯粹的加密货币业务进一步拓展至传统证券交易领域。

头部加密交易所上线美股期权，标志着数字资产平台与传统金融进一步融合。此举拓宽了币安的产品线，并可能加剧与传统券商之间的竞争，吸引希望在同一平台交易加密货币和股票的投资者。

美股期权是与美国上市个股挂钩的衍生品合约，在固定到期日下提供杠杆化敞口。这一新增功能使币安不仅与其他加密交易所竞争，也与成熟的证券经纪商直接竞争。
summary.en:
Binance has expanded its multi-asset trading platform to include U.S. stock options, giving users access to traditional equity derivatives alongside crypto assets. The move extends Binance beyond its original cryptocurrency-only offering into conventional securities trading.

A top-tier crypto exchange adding U.S. stock options signals continued convergence between digital-asset platforms and traditional finance. It broadens Binance's product suite and could intensify competition with conventional brokers for traders who want both crypto and equities in one venue.

U.S. stock options are derivative contracts tied to individual U.S.-listed equities, offering leveraged exposure with a fixed expiry. The addition positions Binance to compete with established securities brokers rather than only with other crypto exchanges.

title.zh: 怀俄明州为 FRNT 稳定币引入 Chainlink 储备证明
title.en: Wyoming Adopts Chainlink Proof of Reserve for FRNT Stable Token

summary.zh:
怀俄明州稳定币委员会已于周三采用 Chainlink 的 Proof of Reserve（储备证明），将 FRNT 的储备和代币供应量以近乎实时的链上验证方式发布。该集成补充了现有的每日认证，并先于计划中的 Chainlink Secure Mint 执行功能落地。

这标志着美国州级发行的稳定币对 Chainlink 的一次重要机构级采用，为法币支持的代币化资产带来了近乎实时的透明度。此举巩固了 Chainlink 在受监管代币化金融领域的地位，并可能为其他公共发行人提供可借鉴的链上储备验证模板。

FRNT 于今年 1 月在怀俄明州稳定币委员会框架下推出，由美元和短期美国国债支持，储备产生的利息收入将进入怀俄明州学校基金会计划。该委员会还计划采用 Chainlink 的 Secure Mint 功能，即只有在经核实的储备等于或超过 FRNT 总供应量时，才能铸造新代币。
summary.en:
The Wyoming Stable Token Commission on Wednesday adopted Chainlink Proof of Reserve to publish near-real-time onchain verification of FRNT's reserves and token supply. The integration complements daily attestations and comes ahead of a planned Chainlink Secure Mint enforcement feature.

This marks a notable institutional adoption of Chainlink by a US state-issued stablecoin, bringing near-real-time transparency to a fiat-backed tokenized asset. It strengthens Chainlink's position in regulated tokenized finance and may serve as a template for other public issuers seeking verifiable onchain reserve reporting.

FRNT, which launched in January under the Wyoming Stable Token Commission, is backed by US dollars and short-term US Treasurys, with interest income channeled into Wyoming's School Foundation Program. The commission is also working to adopt Chainlink's Secure Mint, which would require verified reserves to equal or exceed FRNT's total supply before new tokens can be minted.

title.zh: Securitize与Socios合作，将职业球队股权代币化
title.en: Securitize and Socios Partner to Tokenize Sports Team Equity

summary.zh:
Securitize宣布与Socios合作，将职业体育球队的股权进行代币化。该项目将是欧盟DLT试点制度下Securitize获授权的欧洲交易与结算系统推出的首个项目。

这是欧盟正式监管试点框架下较早的真实世界资产（RWA）代币化案例，可为欧洲受监管的链上股权产品树立先例。这可能会鼓励更多体育俱乐部及其他发行人，在球迷互动之外探索所有权代币化。

目前尚未公布具体交易条款或涉及哪些球队。预计Securitize将提供受监管的交易与结算基础设施，而Socios将借助其体育合作网络以及Chiliz等球迷代币体系的粉丝运营经验推动项目落地。
summary.en:
Securitize announced a partnership with Socios to tokenize equity in professional sports teams. The project will be the first to launch on Securitize's authorized European Trading & Settlement System under the EU DLT Pilot Regime.

This is an early real-world asset tokenization use case within a formal EU regulatory pilot and could create a precedent for regulated on-chain equity in Europe. It may also encourage sports franchises and other issuers to explore tokenized ownership alongside fan engagement.

No transaction terms or specific teams have been disclosed. Securitize is expected to provide the regulated trading and settlement infrastructure, while Socios will contribute its sports partnerships and fan-engagement experience through fan-token ecosystems such as Chiliz.

title.zh: World 开源零知识身份证明工具包 ProveKit
title.en: World Open-Sources ProveKit, a Zero-Knowledge Identity Toolkit

summary.zh:
World 已将客户端零知识身份证明工具包 ProveKit 开源，该工具使用 Rust 编写并提供 WebAssembly 绑定。ProveKit 自 4 月起就已投入 World ID 的生产环境使用。

此举让身份与隐私开发者能够获得经过生产验证的工具包，直接在用户设备上生成和验证零知识证明，无需可信设置或服务器往返。这降低了在 Web 与 Web3 应用中构建私密“人类身份证明”系统的门槛。

该工具包将 prover、verifier 和电路编译器集成到一个轻量级组件中，可把 Noir 电路转换为可验证的 WHIR 证明。开发者可以在本地、Rust 服务、浏览器、iOS/Android，或通过 Groth16 递归验证器在链上完成证明验证。
summary.en:
World has open-sourced ProveKit, its client-side zero-knowledge identity proving toolkit built in Rust with WebAssembly bindings. ProveKit has already been used in production by World ID since April.

This gives identity and privacy developers access to a production-tested toolkit that can generate and verify zero-knowledge proofs directly on users' devices, without trusted setups or server round-trips. It lowers the barrier to building private 'proof of human' systems on the web and in Web3 applications.

The toolkit bundles a prover, verifier, and circuit compiler into a single lightweight package, and can turn a Noir circuit into a verifiable WHIR proof. Verification is supported locally, in a Rust service, in the browser, on iOS or Android, or on-chain via a Groth16 recursive verifier.
